stations.title: Station 1: Introduction to PicToBlox & Animal Racing
stations.desc: Learn how to navigate the PicToBlox workspace, drag color-coded puzzle blocks, and program your very first sprite race!
stations.story:
🐻 Hello, creative future coder!

I am your friend Tobi the Coding Bear 🐻, and today I will accompany you on a magical block coding adventure to build Station 1: Introduction to PicToBlox & Animal Racing! 🌟

🎯 Key Points Covered in this Session:
  • 🐻 PicToBlox Workspace Layout: Exploring the Stage (preview), Blocks Palette (drawers), and Script Area (workspace).
  • 🐻 Dragging & Snapping Blocks: Combining blocks vertically like Lego blocks to build sequences.
  • 🐻 Stage Coordinate System: Moving sprites along horizontal X and vertical Y grid axes.
⛳ Session Objectives:
  • 🎯 Position the racing sprites on the left boundary using coordinate blocks.
  • 🎯 Make your favorite animal sprite glide smoothly to the finish line.
🏆 Session Project: Animal Racing Game: Program a rabbit and a turtle sprite to compete in a race to the finish line, playing cheering sounds when they cross!

🧱 New Puzzle Blocks Introduced:
  • go to x:() y:() (Motion drawer): Instantly teleports the sprite to a specific X and Y spot on the Stage grid.
  • glide () secs to x:() y:() (Motion drawer): Moves the sprite smoothly to a target spot on the grid over a specified time.
  • say () for () seconds (Looks drawer): Displays a text bubble containing your message on the screen for a set duration.
  • start sound () (Sound drawer): Plays a fun sound effect instantly without pausing the rest of the block commands.

Let's drag or click the helper block pill below to run the simulation and unlock this station's medal! You've got this! 🌟🚀
stations.simple: Imagine PicToBlox blocks are like Lego blocks! You snap one block on top of another to build a towering command that tells your sprite exactly where to go!
stations.hint: Type in the editor: print("Animal Racing active!") and press Run!
stations.challenge: Print the exact message: Animal Racing active! to simulate the race track startup.

  • show / hide (Looks drawer): Instantly shows or hides your character sprite from the Stage layout.

stations.title: Station 3: Sensing & Conditions (Maze Game)

stations.story:

🏆 Session Project: Maze Game: Draw a maze backdrop and program a mouse sprite that moves with keyboard arrow keys, bouncing back to the start if it touches the walls!

🧱 New Puzzle Blocks Introduced:
  • if <> then (Control drawer): Runs blocks inside only when the hexagonal condition inside is met.
  • key () pressed? (Sensing drawer): Checks if a specific keyboard key (like arrow keys) is currently held down.
  • touching color ()? (Sensing drawer): Detects if your sprite is overlapping with a specific background color.
  • change x by () / change y by () (Motion drawer): Moves the sprite left/right (x-axis) or up/down (y-axis) by coordinate points.
